details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .github/workflows/forward-merge-stable-to-main.yml:388-393 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: The fallback PR dispatch does not forward `allow_workflow_edits`, so the review workflow can ignore the repo safety toggle.
  WHY: On `workflow_dispatch`, `internal-review.yml` evaluates the input directly instead of consulting `vars.ALLOW_WORKFLOW_EDITS`, which bypasses the configured workflow-edit policy.
- .github/workflows/forward-merge-stable-to-main.yml:326-340 | severity=medium | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: When a fallback PR already exists, the branch never exports `pr_number`, so the downstream review dispatch is skipped.
  WHY: The later `if: steps.fallback.outputs.pr_number != ''` guard stays false on reruns/concurrent runs, leaving the PR to wait for poller-driven handling instead of immediate review dispatch.
- .github/workflows/forward-merge-stable-to-main.yml:388-390 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603]
  PROBLEM: The GH_TOKEN environment assignment may not use the intended token precedence.
  WHY: The review dispatch can run with the wrong credential if the fallback expression selects `github.token` unexpectedly, which changes the auth context used by `gh workflow run`.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:3156-3199 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The blobless recovery fetch can expand `_merge_refspecs` when that array is not populated on the normal path.
  WHY: Reviewers report the retry fetch depends on `_merge_refspecs` being in scope, and an unbound expansion can abort the shell before the recovery merge runs.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:3177-3203 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: `merge_promisor_fetch_failure_seen` is reused across the retry merge, so a later non-promisor exit-128 can still be tagged as a promisor fetch failure.
  WHY: The fail-open behavior remains, but the diagnostic token becomes stale and can misattribute the retry failure in downstream logs.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:3160-3175 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: After the backfill retry, the recovery path does not re-establish a known-good merge state before continuing.
  WHY: Reviewers report the code can fall through as if the merge were clean even when the retry leaves conflict artifacts or other dirty state behind.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:3165-3173 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: The backfill `git fetch --refetch` has no explicit timeout guard.
  WHY: On large repositories, the fetch can consume a substantial share of the job’s wall-clock budget before the merge retry and later resolver stages run.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:3194-3211 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The new `AUTOFIX_PRE_REVIEW_MERGE_TOPOLOGY` result token is not covered by the stable log-prefix contract.
  WHY: Downstream log analysis and drift-audit tooling that keys off documented stable prefixes can miss or misparse the new variant.
- scripts/review_conflict_prepare.sh:129-155 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The recovery path reads `_merge_stderr_file` without first validating that it is readable.
  WHY: Missing or unreadable stderr data can mask the promisor-failure signal and make the recovery branch diagnose the wrong condition.
- scripts/review_conflict_prepare.sh:149-155 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: The backfill refetch can omit `TARGET_BRANCH`, so target-branch blobs may never be materialized.
  WHY: If the missing objects only exist on the target branch, the resolver can hit the same promisor-fetch failure again after the retry.
- scripts/review_conflict_prepare.sh:150-155 & 235-244 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The resolver merge-replay recovery reuses stale promisor-failure state alongside the refspec backfill logic.
  WHY: The recovery block can claim success while leaving the conflict set unresolved or producing an empty allowlist.
- scripts/review_conflict_prepare.sh:144-158 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: The backfill `git fetch --refetch` in the resolver path has no explicit timeout guard.
  WHY: On large repositories, the fetch can consume enough of the resolver step’s wall-clock budget to delay or prevent conflict resolution.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "the pre-review merge gate now detects a promisor fetch failure in the merge stderr, drops the partial-clone filter, refetches the merge inputs ... and retries the merge once. Its exit-128 branch now fails open on a promisor fetch failure"
  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml (pre-review merge gate)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  EVIDENCE: The recovery block references `_merge_refspecs` that is not declared on the normal (non-shallow) execution path, `merge_promisor_fetch_failure_seen` is never reset, and post-retry `git ls-files --unmerged` is not re-evaluated before clearing failure state.
- requirement: "scripts/review_conflict_prepare.sh — the same blob-backfill + retry around the resolver's own `git merge` replay, so the resolver doesn't see an empty conflict set and abort with 'nothing to resolve'."
  expected_change_site: scripts/review_conflict_prepare.sh (merge-replay block)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  EVIDENCE: The same scoping and state-reset bugs exist in the parallel recovery logic, so the resolver can still abort with an empty allowlist on the promisor-failure signature the change was meant to fix.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:3177-3203 | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: `merge_promisor_fetch_failure_seen` is never reset before the retry merge, so an unrelated exit-128 on the retry can still be logged as `merge_precheck_promisor_fetch_failed`.
  WHY: The fail-open behavior remains correct, but the diagnostic token becomes stale and can misattribute the retry failure.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:3194-3211 | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The new `AUTOFIX_PRE_REVIEW_MERGE_TOPOLOGY` result token is not covered by the stable log-prefix contract.
  WHY: Downstream log analysis and drift-audit tooling that keys off documented stable prefixes can miss or misparse the new variant.
=== END FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===
- .github/workflows/forward-merge-stable-to-main.yml:388-390 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The dispatch step does not pass `allow_workflow_edits` to `internal-review.yml`.
  WHY: On `workflow_dispatch`, `internal-review.yml` evaluates the input directly and the repo safety toggle is not forwarded, so workflow edits are prevented or allowed independently of the configured policy.
- .github/workflows/forward-merge-stable-to-main.yml:326-332 | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: When a fallback PR already exists, the workflow does not extract the PR number.
  WHY: The later dispatch step is gated on `steps.fallback.outputs.pr_number != ''`, so reruns on a pre-existing PR do not dispatch the review workflow.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:3194, 3206 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The new `AUTOFIX_PRE_REVIEW_MERGE_TOPOLOGY` log prefix/result token is not documented in the stable log-prefix contract.
  WHY: Downstream workflow-log-analysis and drift-audit tooling that depends on documented stable prefixes may miss or misparse the new variant.
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM mistralai_mistral-small-2603 ===
- .github/workflows/forward-merge-stable-to-main.yml:388-390 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Using `${{ secrets.GH_PAT || github.token }}` in the env block can lead to incorrect token precedence.
  WHY: The workflow may run with the fallback token instead of the intended PAT, so the auth context for `gh workflow run` can be wrong.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:3177-3199 | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The blobless recovery block references `_merge_refspecs` without a local declaration visible in the normal execution path.
  WHY: If the array is not in scope when the recovery path runs, shell execution can fail with an unbound-variable error and abort the workflow step.
- scripts/review_conflict_prepare.sh:136-155 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The recovery block processes `_merge_stderr_file` without validating existence/readability first.
  WHY: Missing or unreadable diagnostics can make the promisor-failure check fall through and mask the real recovery condition.
- scripts/review_conflict_prepare.sh:150-155 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The backfill `_backfill_refspecs` array conditionally includes `TARGET_BRANCH`, which may not be wired by the caller.
  WHY: If target-branch history is required to materialize blobs, the refetch can omit it and still hit the promisor-failure path downstream.
- .github/workflows/forward-merge-stable-to-main.yml:326-332 | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: When a fallback PR already exists, the workflow does not populate `pr_number`.
  WHY: The later dispatch step is gated on that output, so reruns with an existing fallback PR skip the review dispatch.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:3194, 3206 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The `AUTOFIX_PRE_REVIEW_MERGE_TOPOLOGY` result token is introduced but not documented in the stable log-prefix contract.
  WHY: Downstream log-analysis and drift-audit tooling that rely on documented stable prefixes may miss or misparse the new variant.
=== END FINDINGS FROM mistralai_mistral-small-2603 ===

  PROBLEM: The blobless recovery block references `_merge_refspecs` without a declaration in the visible scope.
  WHY: If `_merge_refspecs` is undefined, the shell can fail before the recovery fetch and merge retry run.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:3177-3199 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `merge_promisor_fetch_failure_seen` is never reset before the retry merge.
  WHY: An unrelated retry exit-128 can still be logged as a promisor-fetch failure, creating misleading diagnostics.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:3160-3175 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: After the backfill retry, the code does not re-verify that the merge is still clean before proceeding.
  WHY: A partial recovery that leaves conflicts or artifacts behind can be misclassified as a successful clean merge.
- .github/workflows/forward-merge-stable-to-main.yml:382-396 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The fallback PR dispatch does not pass `allow_workflow_edits`.
  WHY: When `vars.ALLOW_WORKFLOW_EDITS=false`, the review workflow can still allow workflow-file edits on the fallback PR path.
- .github/workflows/forward-merge-stable-to-main.yml:333-338 | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The "PR already exists" branch does not populate `pr_number`.
